name: taskagent
description: Eigent-style multi-agent autonomous workflow powered by GitHub Copilot

commands.name: research
commands.description: Research a topic and generate a report

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_executeCode
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute code in terminal or run scripts. Use this when you need to run shell commands, execute Python/Node.js scripts, or perform any code execution task.

code.description: The code or command to execute

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_webSearch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the web for information. Use this when you need to find current information, research topics, or gather data from the internet.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_browseWebpage
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open and extract content from a webpage. Use this when you need to read the content of a specific URL.

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_createDocument
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create or edit documents and files. Use this when you need to generate reports, create files, or manage documents.

filename.description: Name of the file to create

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_humanInput
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Request input or confirmation from the user when uncertain or when an important decision needs human approval.

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_writeNote
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Write a note to share findings with other agents. Use this to record important information that other agents can read. This is essential for agent coordination.

taskId.description: Optional task ID to scope the note

agentId.description: ID of the agent writing the note (developer, search, document, browser, multimodal)

content.description: Content of the note with findings and information

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_readNote
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read notes from other agents to get context and findings. ALWAYS read notes before starting complex tasks to see what other agents have discovered.

taskId.description: Optional task ID to scope the notes

fromAgent.description: Optional: only read notes from this specific agent

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_codeSearch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search for text or patterns in the codebase. Use this to find function definitions, variable usages, or any code pattern across the workspace.

query.description: The text or pattern to search for

includePattern.description: Optional glob pattern for folders to include, e.g., src/**

excludePattern.description: Optional glob pattern for folders to exclude

isRegex.description: Whether the query is a regex pattern

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_findFiles
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find files in the workspace by name or glob pattern. Use this to locate files like 'package.json', '*.config.ts', or 'src/**/*.tsx'.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g., **/*.ts, src/**/*.py

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_readFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the contents of a file in the workspace. Use this to examine code, configuration, or any text file.

filePath.description: Relative path to the file from workspace root

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_getSymbols
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get all symbols (functions, classes, methods, variables) from a file. Use this to understand the structure of a code file.

filePath.description: Relative path to the file from workspace root

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_securityReview
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate a comprehensive Security Review document for a feature or API. Analyzes: 1) Feature overview, 2) System architecture & data flow, 3) Permissions & credentials, 4) External dependencies, 5) Data classification & privacy impact, 6) Request/Response analysis (user content, response values, required permissions). Use this when you need to create security documentation for code review.

featureName.description: Name of the feature or API being reviewed

targetFiles.description: List of file paths to analyze for security issues

outputPath.description: Path to save the security review document (e.g., docs/security-review.md)

includeDataFlow.description: Whether to include data flow analysis (default: true)

includePermissions.description: Whether to include permissions analysis (default: true)

languageModelTools.name: taskagent_analyzeScenario
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deep security analysis for an entire scenario/feature. Performs comprehensive analysis including: 1) UPSTREAM API analysis - finds all callers, HTTP methods, routes that invoke this scenario; 2) DOWNSTREAM API analysis - traces all external API calls (Microsoft Graph, Azure AD, Key Vault, etc.) and database operations; 3) CALL STACK tracing - step-by-step execution path from entry to exit; 4) PERMISSION/SCOPE extraction - identifies required Graph API permissions (User.Read, Group.ReadWrite.All, etc.) with access levels; 5) CREDENTIAL scanning - detects AppID, ClientSecret, API Keys with risk classification; 6) DATA FLOW analysis - tracks PII and user content through the system; 7) MERMAID SEQUENCE DIAGRAM - generates visual flow diagram. Outputs a structured security review document to docs/ folder. Use this for comprehensive security reviews of complex features.

scenarioName.description: Name of the scenario or feature to analyze (e.g., 'User Authentication Flow', 'Data Export API')

scenarioDescription.description: Description of what the scenario does

entryPoint.description: Optional entry point file or function (e.g., 'src/api/auth.ts:login' or 'src/controllers/UserController.ts')

searchKeywords.description: Additional keywords to search for related code

outputPath.description: Path to save the security review document (e.g., 'docs/security/auth-review.md')
